scope: One 64m magic street: two residences, two two-storey shops and one furnished fountain plaza. Model D chooses layout, E chooses per-site parameters, F reviews actual local feature report. Local construction uses existing detailed single-building geometry, not legacy scene planning.
policy: Run exactly one original case, preserving every started request/failure. No overwrite. New paid retry after exhaustion requires another registration. Baseline and exact replay are offline and separate from the real sample.
success: Valid source WIR/worldpkg and detailed GLB, exact zero-network replay, Unity actual load/reopen and same-camera baseline/API screenshots; test streets, entrances and required upper floors in the target. F alone cannot certify target or appearance.
limitations: One fixed-scope case is not general city generation or population reliability. Minecraft and full castle are deferred. Colour-only materials and stepped roofs remain visible. Human appearance review pending until user sees comparison.
